title: Cozy Tunisian Tomato Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful stew inspired by the rich culinary traditions of Tunisia. This hearty dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the ground cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chili paste and ground beef (if using) and cook until the meat is browned.
Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
